parameter_status: Provisional research assumptions, not validated trading rules

rules.bullish_fvg: C3.low > C1.high; [C1.high, C3.low] at C3 close
rules.bearish_fvg: C3.high < C1.low; [C3.high, C1.low] at C3 close
rules.displacement: Directionally aligned C2 body with abs(close-open)/C2 ATR >= body_atr_min and C2 body_ratio >= body_ratio_min
rules.normalization: Both displacement and FVG width use C2 ATR; atr_normalized_body is audited against the signed formula; body_ratio is reused
rules.precision: Feature consistency comparison rel_tol=1e-8, abs_tol=1e-10; geometry and threshold comparisons remain strict/inclusive respectively
rules.missing_data: No imputation; unusable evidence cannot qualify displacement but valid strict FVG geometry remains eligible
rules.input_errors: Invalid OHLC or nonconsecutive/malformed timestamps fail the run with a CSV line reference
rules.event_policy: Body at own close; later aligned FVG confirmation shares ID without rewriting prior events; --fvg-only emits creations only
rules.counting: Count create rows or distinct zone_id for independent candidates, not every event row
rules.ordering: Chronological availability; at one close, prior-middle FVG precedes current-candle body

field_meanings.zone_id: Deterministic independent-candidate identity; a later aligned FVG confirmation reuses the body ID
field_meanings.symbol/source_timeframe: Input asset and candle interval; no cross-asset or cross-timeframe detection
field_meanings.zone_family/imbalance_type/direction: imbalance; bullish_fvg, bearish_fvg or displacement_body; bullish or bearish
field_meanings.lower_price/upper_price: Interval known at this event; exact FVG gap or impulse body without padding
field_meanings.formation_start_utc: C1 opening for FVG; impulse opening for displacement body
field_meanings.available_at_utc: Availability of this row: C3 close for FVG, impulse close for body
field_meanings.candidate_created_at_utc: Original independent-candidate creation time; unchanged by FVG confirmation
field_meanings.c1_time_utc/c2_time_utc/c3_time_utc: Three candle openings for FVG; only impulse/c2 populated for body
field_meanings.reference_atr/reference_atr_available_at: Impulse candle ATR and its close time; never C3 ATR for FVG evidence
field_meanings.gap_width/gap_width_atr: FVG upper-lower and gap/C2 ATR; blank for body; normalized value blank for unusable ATR
field_meanings.zone_width: upper_price-lower_price for every row, including displacement body
field_meanings.displacement_body_atr/displacement_body_: Absolute impulse body/impulse ATR, and validated Phase 1 body_ratio; valid weak/opposed values retained
field_meanings.aligned_displacement: FVG direction matches strong impulse; false on body creation because no FVG is known then
field_meanings.candidate_status: candidate; no fill, mitigation, lifecycle or validity conclusion
field_meanings.event_type: create or fvg_confirmation; confirmation adds FVG evidence without a second independent creation

limitations: OHLC bodies are provisional interval proxies, not verified liquidity voids
FVG geometry is an OHLC pattern, not evidence of market inefficiency or future price response
To preserve immediate displacement knowledge and avoid duplicate independent IDs, default CSVs include FVG confirmation rows as well as creations
Body-only counts are as-of-input-end counts, not a historical feature; the final impulse may acquire FVG evidence after the dataset ends
No fill, mitigation, invalidation, zone merging, strength, outcome or scenario inference
A failed input validation can leave partial generated files; failures return nonzero and no new success summary is written
